title: Say it out loud. It’s closer.
lead: A real-time conversation in their voice. When it’s your turn, a light rises from the bottom of the screen; when they answer, it moves to them. Each call is transcribed into your chat, too.
fanCaption: Guess what, something good happened today
oshiCaption: Wait, what? Tell me everything, Hina.
trust: If a call doesn’t connect, you’re not charged.
billing: You’re only charged for the time you could hear them.
stageAlt: Illustration of a voice call with a creator’s AI clone. The light moves to whoever is speaking.
